div.div:
configure
CMake copies galimatron/tests/test_data to <build>/bin/galimatron_test_data (deleting the
old copy), copies the shared gal.cfg, log.cfg, xslt/config.xml into the cases, and on
Windows the expected-xml-windows files over expected-xml

div.div:
the rules
• product and slice tests never touch file bytes: only compare_directories and exception checks
• oracles hold no absolute path: a path is relative to the gal.cfg folder with / (report_path, committed-report)
• // good and // bad mark the line of an automated .gal fixture
• change a file that has a Windows twin → change both
• names must match in case (Linux)
